brief:
Israeli occupation authorities have begun a settlement project targeting 700 dunams of agricultural land near the Naama settlement in the Jordan Valley, Shehab Wire reported. The initiative is part of broader plans to expand agriculture and consolidate control over Palestinian territory in the region.

The project represents the latest in a series of settlement expansion efforts in the Jordan Valley, where Israeli authorities have accelerated land seizures and agricultural development schemes in recent years.

title: Israel launches settlement project targeting 700 dunams in Jordan Valley
